title: Isolated Health incremental ingestion contract
description: New fragment for explicit owner integration; does not modify any existing contract. This endpoint is not the complete-window snapshot endpoint.

HealthIncrementalRequest.title: HealthIncrementalRequest
HealthIncrementalRequest.description: POST /health/v1/incremental. Authenticated account comes only from the service. One persistent stream per account/data_epoch/hk_type; sequence starts at zero and advances only with durable outbox admission. Replays retain identical request identity and payload. Initial step baseline publishes only after has_more=false, including an explicit empty terminal page if required. Temporal order, immutable UUID identity, epoch, consent and cross-field clinical semantics are additionally validated by the server. An addition and deletion of the same UUID in one page resolves to deletion. Server-enforced bounds additionally include 262144 encoded bytes, seven-day sample intervals, 500 initial data pages plus an optional empty terminal page, and 50000 retained UUID mappings. No account selector is accepted. Samples use excluded_reason=null normally; unsupported workout activities or sleep categories require an explicit matching exclusion reason and null unmapped value. Exclusions receive a durable UUID acknowledgement and an excluded count, never fabricated normalized values. Expired additions are acknowledged in the receipt expired count without restoring raw records; current additions and explicit deletions in that page still commit. Future-invalid timestamps remain errors. Minimal payload-bound acknowledgments persist for the account epoch independently of generic receipt pruning.
